findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a the old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) but the new light branch is scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). The PR intent is to keep the light-theme value identical and only add a dark-theme fallback via $secondary. Changing 30% to 70% visibly lightens the link on light themes and is inconsistent with the 30%->70% mapping used elsewhere.

findings.title: group-member-info .name light value changed 30% to 50%
findings.body: Old code was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). New code is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). Both branches are wrong: light should stay 30% and dark should be 70% to sum to 100% like common/base/user.scss. This alters light-theme appearance and gives wrong dark-theme contrast.

findings.title: group-member-info .name light value changed 30% to 50%
findings.body: Same as desktop: old scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) was replaced with dark-light-choose with 50%/50% values. Light-theme color is unintentionally changed and dark-theme fallback should be 70% lightness on $secondary, not 50%.

findings.title: topic-map h3 light value changed 20% to 50%
findings.body: Old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). New value is dark-light-choose with 50%/50%. Preserving light theme requires keeping 20% for $primary and using 80% for $secondary. The current 50% makes headings much lighter on light themes.

findings.title: custom-message-length light/dark values inverted
findings.body: Old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). New light branch is scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) with dark branch 70% on $secondary. The light branch must stay 70% and dark branch should be 30% per desktop/modal.scss. As written both light and dark themes get the wrong shade.
